items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps young skin comfortable without stripping it.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports the skin barrier and adds comfort, since moisture is only moderate.
A mineral SPF 50 worn each morning is the one habit that really helps skin look its best over time.

response.routine_note: We've left out retinol, vitamin C serum and the 30% peel because strong anti-aging products aren't made for under-13 skin, and your scan shows nothing that calls for them; cleanse, moisturize and apply sunscreen each morning, ideally with a parent or guardian helping you choose. If a skin concern ever bothers you, a dermatologist is the right person to ask.
